Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session; onsite vs virtual?

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the call earlier. FastLane is excited to get the POC kickoff scheduled. Our core ask is a 3-hour, hands-on working session where we:
- walk through prompt review and expected outputs,
- validate routing for our multi-tenant flows, and
- run a short load test (~100 concurrent simulated users for 10 mins) to validate latency under burst.

We're flexible on format (fully virtual or hybrid/onsite). Preference would be hybrid so our engineers can pair with your team for the routing setup, but that depends on visitor access policies at our HQ. Proposed dates: Feb 22–24 (afternoons). Can you confirm Redwood's lead and whether you can do recording? We'll also need to confirm room AV and screen-sharing permissions.

Attached a quick list of topics we want covered.

Thanks,
Lisa

Hi Lisa — great to hear. Feb 23 (afternoon) works best for our team. Proposed plan (3.5 hours):
1) 15m intro + goals alignment
2) 45m prompt review and evaluation sets (we'll bring examples)
3) 60m routing & config workshop (can pair-program with your engs)
4) 30m load test & quick analysis
5) 20m wrap, next steps, rollout checklist

Monica will own the load-test window and model variant selection; Grace will handle the customer-facing agenda and logistics. A few asks from our side:
- For hybrid: guest badges and AV access for two Redwood engineers (screen share + local admin for laptop HDMI).
- Recording: we generally record sessions for internal follow-up but will only share recordings per your permission. If legal needs to approve, we can mute recordings for demos with customer data.
- Please confirm the list of onsite attendees and any facility contact for room booking.

Draft agenda attached. If the site access is a blocker, we can run fully virtual with low-friction pairing via remote desktop.

Best,
